key_insight: This review maps bias in AI-based disease detection and highlights data diversity, explainability, and fairness-aware design as priorities for more equitable systems.
clinical_relevance: Recognizing bias may help clinicians and health systems assess whether diagnostic AI performs equitably across patient populations.
method: Reviewed disease-detection AI studies within a stated 2015–2026 window.
Classified approaches by input data, model architecture, and bias type.
Examined algorithmic, demographic, model, and deployment bias and mitigation approaches.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports reviewing 23 articles from 64,389 records analyzed across seven digital libraries, without quantitative performance or fairness results.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish whether proposed mitigation approaches improve fairness in real-world clinical deployment.
paper_title: Fairness or Fallacy? Mapping the Landscape of AI Bias in Disease Detection
